name: mcp-management
description: A Node.js MCP server that loads plugins, registers tools via the MCP SDK, and exposes functionality over stdio with built-in persistence and a Next.js web UI. It provides a management stack for MCP tools with plugin lifecycle management and security controls.

rawRecord.description: A Node.js MCP server that loads plugins, registers tools via the MCP SDK, and exposes functionality over stdio with built-in persistence and a Next.js web UI. It provides a management stack for MCP tools with plugin lifecycle management and security controls.

MCP_DATA_DIR.description: Directory for JSON state and logs; default is ~/.mcp-management on the current user.

MCP_FS_ALLOWED_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated paths for filesystem-related tooling; respects blocked OS paths.

MCP_IN_MEMORY_PERSISTENCE.description: Enable in-memory persistence; set to true or use when NODE_ENV=test.

MCP_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_PLUGINS.description: Allow external plugin loaders (path, package, bundle); set to true to enable.
